# meok-nis2-nl-register-mcp

> NIS2 Netherlands Registration MCP (Wbni-2). Classifies entities Annex I (essential) / Annex II (important), generates NCSC-NL portal payload, emits HMAC-signed Article 21 attestation. Deadline June 2026. By MEOK AI Labs.

MCP server by MEOK AI Labs. Framework: fastmcp. Transport: stdio.

## Tools
- classify_entity
- generate_registration_packet
- list_sectors
- check_deadline_status
- sign_readiness_attestation

## Install
```
pip install meok-nis2-nl-register-mcp
```

## Links
- PyPI: https://pypi.org/project/meok-nis2-nl-register-mcp/
